title: Balanced Veggie Patch Salad
subtitle: with Dukkah, Freekeh and Feta
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

steps.text: Cook freekeh: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Cook the freekeh, partially covered, for 18-20 mins until tender. Drain.

Bake potato: Meanwhile, cut the unpeeled potato into 2cm chunks. Put the potato on a lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, scatter over half the dukkah, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Bake on the upper oven shelf for 25 mins or until tender and golden.
Bake tomatoes: Put the tomatoes on the remaining lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Bake on the lower shelf for 15 mins or until blistered.

Make dressing: While the veggies are baking, crush 1 small garlic clove (see Kitchen 101). Pick the mint leaves, discarding the stems. Finely chop half the mint leaves. Combine the garlic, chopped mint, remaining dukkah, 1 tbs olive oil, 1 tbs white wine vinegar and 2 tsp honey in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Add the freekeh, potato and rocket to the dressing and toss to combine. Divide the salad and roasted tomatoes among bowls. Scatter with the remaining mint and crumble over the feta. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Garlic used raw is best crushed in a garlic crusher or finely minced with a knife – adding a little salt to the garlic on the chopping board helps break it down.
